polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of November 2026.  This month's big sale is the 11.11 mega sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your biggest lever for higher profit this month is driving traffic to your highest-margin channel—direct sales via Instagram/WhatsApp and your website—while keeping ad spend efficient. Right now, pop-up bazaars and direct channels yield ~60–63% profit per unit versus ~47–55% on marketplaces after fees. Your cash buffer (MYR 15k) lets you invest in targeted promo without risking cash flow.

1. **Run a 11.11 flash sale on Instagram/WhatsApp and your website only** – Offer 15% off site-wide for 48 hours (Nov 10–11), promoted via Story ads targeting past engagers (budget MYR 500). Expect ~200 orders at avg. basket MYR 120 → MYR 24k revenue, ~MYR 14.4k profit (60% margin) minus MYR 500 ads = ~MYR 13.9k net.  
2. **Double down on TikTok Live try-ons** – Schedule two 1-hour lives (Nov 9 & 12) featuring 3 best-sellers (wrap dress, linen set, scarf). Offer live-exclusive 10% off code “LIVE11”. Based on your 86 peak viewers, aim for 60 orders → MYR 7.2k revenue, ~MYR 4.3k profit (60% margin) with near-zero ad cost.  
3. **Push repeat buyers to your website** – Email/SMS past 30 buyers (from Sep–Oct) with a MYR 15 voucher for site-only use (valid Nov 1–30). Cost MYR 450. Target 20 redemptions → MYR 3k extra site revenue, ~MYR 1.8k profit (60%). Track via UTM or coupon code.  

Total projected incremental profit: ~MYR 20k this month. Reinvest half into Nov–Dec inventory.
missionsAdded: Host Two TikTok Live Try-On Sessions with Exclusive Offer
Re-engage Past Buyers with Website-Only Voucher

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of December 2026. Last month: 2026-11: sales MYR 16k from 156 orders (130 new, 26 repeat), average order MYR 104. Stock left: 33 pieces (bought 153). Ads MYR 2,400, about MYR 61 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 1,314. Costs MYR 15k, net MYR 1,334. Cash now MYR 16k. Shop rating 4.6. This month's big sale is the 12.12 year-end sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your costs are high relative to revenue—ads eat ~MYR 61 per order while average order value is only MYR 104. To lift profit, focus on reducing ad waste, boosting repeat purchases, and protecting margins during the 12.12 sale.

1. Cut ad spend by testing lower-cost channels: pause broad TikTok/Shopee ads and shift MYR 1,200 of the budget to retargeting past buyers via Instagram/WhatsApp (0% fee) with a “12.12 VIP preview” offer—aim for ≤MYR 20 cost per acquired repeat buyer.
2. Push website-only incentives: add a free silk-touch scarf (cost MYR 12) to every website order ≥MYR 150 during 12.12; track uptake to move ≥30% of sales to the 2.9%+MYR 1/order channel, saving platform fees.
3. Set a minimum profitable price floor: for any item discounted in 12.12, ensure post‑fee margin ≥40% (e.g., satin wrap dress: website price ≥MYR 115 after 2.9%+MYR 1 fee). Use a simple spreadsheet to flag unprofitable discounts before launch.

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of January 2027. Last month: 2026-12: sales MYR 18k from 158 orders (113 new, 45 repeat), average order MYR 115. Stock left: 33 pieces (bought 201). Ads MYR 1,200, about MYR 50 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 1,352. Costs MYR 17k, net MYR 1,592. Cash now MYR 18k. Shop rating 4.6. This month's big sale is the 1.1 New Year sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your December results show strong volume—158 orders—but ad spend ate ~7 % of revenue while platform fees took another 7–9 %. To lift profit, tighten acquisition costs, shift mix to lower-fee channels, and protect margin on the New Year sale.

1. **Audit ad efficiency**: Pull last month’s ad data—TikTok, Shopee, Meta—and calculate ROAS (revenue ÷ ad spend). Pause any channel under 3× ROAS; reallocate that budget to the top performer (likely TikTok given your 86‑viewer live peak) and test a 10 % lookalike audience of your 45 repeat buyers. Target ≤ MYR 30/ad order by month‑end.  
2. **Push website/WhatsApp orders**: Your site fees are just 2.9 % + MYR 1/order vs. Shopee/TikTok fees averaging 8–14 %. Offer a MYR 10 website‑only voucher for repeat buyers (you have 45) and run a 24‑hour flash on 1.11 with free domestic shipping if order ≥ MYR 150. Aim to move at least 20 % of January’s volume off marketplace fees.  
3. **Guard sale margins**: For the New Year sale, discount only slow‑movers (e.g., scarves at MYR 39 → MYR 29) and keep best‑sellers at ≤15 % off. With current COGS, a 15 % off satin wrap dress still nets ~MYR 45 profit versus ~MYR 30 at 30 % off. Track gross profit per sale daily and stop deep discounts if margin falls below 30 %.  

If you’d like, share your ROAS by platform or which SKUs are overstocked—I’ll refine the plan. ✨

What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your January net was only MYR 1,365 despite strong ad spend—ads ate ~MYR 74 per order, which erodes margins fast. To lift profit, tighten ad efficiency, push higher-margin channels like your website, and lock in pre-order cash flow before production.

Pause any ad set delivering < 2× ROAS (revenue ÷ ad spend) and reallocate that budget to retargeting website visitors via Meta/IG ads—website orders keep 97.1% of price vs. ~50‑65% on marketplaces. Aim to cut ad cost per order to ≤ MYR 50 by mid‑February.

Do these three steps and you should see net profit climb toward MYR 2k+ by month‑end. ✨📘

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of April 2027. Last month: 2027-03: sales MYR 18k from 145 orders (78 new, 67 repeat), average order MYR 124. Stock left: 16 pieces (bought 107). Ads MYR 300, about MYR 27 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 1,266. Costs MYR 11k, net MYR 6,989. Cash now MYR 26k. Shop rating 4.6. This month's big sale is the Post-Raya clearance. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your profit last month was strong thanks to low ad spend and high margins, but platform fees ate ~7% of revenue. To lift profit further this April, focus on shifting sales to lower-fee channels, protecting margins during clearance, and turning repeat buyers into higher-value website customers.

1. **Move at least 30% of Post-Raya clearance volume to your website** – Website fees are only 2.9% + MYR 1/order vs. Shopee/TikTok’s 9–14%. If you sell 50 clearance items via website instead of marketplace, you save ~MYR 405 in fees (assuming avg MYR 124 AOV). Promote the website‑only voucher from your open mission “Re-engage Past Buyers with Website-Only Voucher” to drive this shift.

2. **Run a flash‑sale drop on 11.11 (even if early)** – Limited‑time urgency boosts conversion without deep discounts. Target a 15% uplift in AOV by bundling (e.g., scarf + dress) and capping discount at 20% max. With 145 orders last month, a 15% AOV lift to MYR 143 adds ~MYR 420 extra revenue at same volume.

3. **Tighten ad efficiency** – You spent MYR 300 for ~11 ad‑attributed orders (MYR 27/order). Test lookalike audiences based on your 67 repeat buyers and cap daily spend at MYR 8. Aim to cut cost per order to MYR 20 or lower, saving ~MYR 100+ this month while maintaining volume. Track UTM codes to reallocate any waste to website‑only promos.
